title: Cats and Dogs
text: Cats and dogs are both popular pets, but they are quite different. Cats often nap in quiet, sunny spots for most of the day. Dogs love to run and play outside for hours. Cats clean themselves with their own tongue. Dogs need a bath from their owner instead. Both cats and dogs like to curl up next to their family at night.
